title: Out of the Blue & Just for Fun 2 | Iconic Seaside Rental | Exclusive 30A
h1: Out of the Blue and Just for Fun 2
meta_description: Iconic 7-bedroom Seaside estate steps from the beach and town square, featuring two homes, Gulf views, bikes, and full access to Seaside amenities.
description_expanded: Out of the Blue and Just for Fun 2 Features: - Catch a glimpse of the Gulf from the top floor Watchtower - 3 Minute stroll to the E Ruskin Beach Pavilion Access - 1 Minute stroll to the renowned shopping and dining in Seaside Square, including the famous Seaside Food Trucks (you can even order ahead for pickup) - 2 Minute stroll to Adult Pool, Family Pool, and Seaside Fitness Center. Access included with your reservation. The Family Pool is heated and enclosed during cooler months. - Enjoy 6 Taxi Bikes during your stay. The bikes are serviced regularly to ensure they are in top shape for your arrival. - Gourmet Kitchen on the 2nd floor with a built-in refrigerator, four dishwasher drawers, stainless steel appliances including two Sub-Zero refrigerators and freezers, double gas oven, and 6-burner range - Dining table with seating for 10 and breakfast bar seating for 2 in the main home - 2nd floor main living room with 60" flat screen TV - Covered front porch featuring a cushioned seating set and ping pong table. Ping Pong equipment available at the home. - Covered balcony with outdoor dining table, ceiling fan, rocking chairs, and cushioned loveseats - Reading nook between 3rd and 4th floors with twin daybed. Perfect for relaxing, reading, and napping in the afternoon - Top floor lounge with 360-degree views, including the Gulf and all of Seaside - Laundry facilities available in both homes - Fenced-in backyard with outdoor dining and propane grill - Designer interiors throughout the home, recently renovated in 2024 - Detached carriage house with full kitchen, living room, laundry closet, dining area, and covered balcony - WIFI and cable TV - High-end cotton towels and linens - Contactless and keyless entry - Access to Seaside Tennis and Fitness Center included with your reservation. Schedule tennis lessons or rent court time on the Pickleball Courts - Concierge services including beach chair rentals, bike rentals, grocery delivery, and baby equipment rentals available - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) -Access to Seaside Beach private entrances and all Seaside community pools included with your reservation. Some pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available; subject to change by the HOA. - Fireplaces are decorative - Area summer camps and kids' classes available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee - Pets not allowed at the home. Unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction with no refunds. Welcome to Out of the Blue and Just for Fun 2, an iconic Seaside private residence on the best street in Seaside. Seaside Avenue boasts some of Seaside's most prominent and exclusive homes, overlooking the large treelined street that leads directly to the center of town. This deluxe compound is a rare 7-bedroom estate in Seaside which sleeps 18. This one-of-a-kind home features a main home with sleeping for 12 in 5 well-appointed suites plus an adjacent cottage home with sleeping for 6 in two suites. The cottage home includes a living area, full kitchen, deluxe furnished balcony, and outdoor patio with dining area. Enjoy the comfort and decadence of having two fully functional homes on one compound for your crew. Out of the Blue (the main house) offers all the charming architectural details that put Seaside on the map, as well as being a short stroll to the white sand beaches and the Gulf of Mexico. Just steps away from Great Southern Cafe, Modica Market, Sundog Books, and all the lively entertainment of Seaside town square, Into the Blue is superbly located. You can hear the live music from Seaside's Central Square from your porch. Don't worry, Seaside has established quiet hours so you can also enjoy a serene evening outside at your private oasis. Whether you are planning a vacation for the entire family or getting the friends together for a weekend of relaxation at the beach, Out of the Blue and Just for Fun 2 is the perfect estate to relax and enjoy the best of Seaside and 30A. The grand three-story home plus adjacent Cottage Home is positioned well on Seaside Avenue, just steps from Central Square, Black Bear Bakery and the shops and restaurants in town, as well as the East Ruskin private beach pavilion.
